Name: Carcassonne
Description: The tile-laying board game: build roads, cities and cloisters, and place followers to claim them.

Achievements.Name: Apprentice
Achievements.Description: Win your first game of Carcassonne.

Achievements.Name: Graduate
Achievements.Description: Complete the Basic and the River II tutorial.

Achievements.Name: Abbot
Achievements.Description: Score two adjacent lying cloisters.

Achievements.Name: Burgomaster
Achievements.Description: Score a City with at least 9 tiles.

Achievements.Name: Emperor of Carcassonne
Achievements.Description: Score a total of 15,000+ points from all your Carcassonne games combined.

Achievements.Name: Road Warden
Achievements.Description: Score a road with at least five tiles.

Achievements.Name: Lone Wolf
Achievements.Description: Win a game of Carcassonne with at least 50 points more than the second best player.

Achievements.Name: Shepherd
Achievements.Description: Score at least 30 points with farms in a single game.

Achievements.Name: Count of Carcassonne
Achievements.Description: Win a game with at least 150 points.

Achievements.Name: Missionary
Achievements.Description: Win a game without having any followers left in your pool.

Achievements.Name: Scrooge
Achievements.Description: Win a game with at least four followers left in your pool.

Achievements.Name: Duke of Carcassonne
Achievements.Description: Finish 200 games of Carcassonne.

Achievements.Name: Builder
Achievements.Description: Score with your first completed building.

Achievements.Name: Duelist
Achievements.Description: Outnumber an opponent in an embattled completed building.

Achievements.Name: Hello Hefaistos
Achievements.Description: Create a volcano.

Achievements.Name: The First Crusade
Achievements.Description: Win your first Xbox LIVE game of Carcassonne.

Achievements.Name: Best of the Best
Achievements.Description: Win a Xbox LIVE game, where all seats have been taken.

Achievements.Name: Knight of Carcassonne
Achievements.Description: Finish 20 games of Carcassonne.

Achievements.Name: Secular Power
Achievements.Description: Win a game without scoring any cloister points.

Achievements.Name: Ring Ring!
Achievements.Description: Download the Carcassonne ringtone to your device.
